description: An electric dark dev-tool pricing page built around an interactive slider calculator that live-computes included quota plus tiered pay-as-you-go overage, with a lime accent, a highlighted plan card row, and an FAQ accordion.

title: Petal · Soft SaaS Website Design from Prompts (pastel-friendly)
description: A soft pastel SaaS marketing site on a lavender page with a floating pill nav, a deep-plum hero with a live-canvas mockup, coral and mint hand-tilted italic accents, a playful stat trio, a prompt-library band, testimonials, 2-tier pricing, and a dark footer.

title: Editorial Crimson Dev-Tool Pricing
description: A light, serif-accented SaaS pricing page on white with a single crimson accent, audience segmented tabs, a monthly/annual toggle, and a 4-tier grid with one elevated 'most popular' card.

title: Midnight Navy Fintech Pricing
description: A deep-navy, teal-accented SaaS/fintech pricing page with a sticky blurred nav, monthly/annual toggle, and a glowing 'Most popular' middle tier across three cards.

title: Hairline Mono-Minimal SaaS Pricing
description: A frameless light-mode SaaS pricing page in editorial mono-minimal style: warm off-white paper, hairline-divided three-tier cards with an inverted dark Pro tier, indigo accent, a monthly/annual toggle, and a clean comparison table.

title: Warm Neo-Brutalist SaaS Pricing
description: A neo-brutalist pricing page on a warm cream canvas with hard-shadowed cards, a 3-tier layout, a monthly/annual toggle, and a bold Archivo Black display face.

title: Editorial Serif Atelier Pricing
description: A warm, magazine-style 3-tier SaaS pricing page on cream paper with oversized serif type, terracotta accents, a monthly/annual pill toggle, and a single inverted dark 'Popular' tier.

title: Editorial Violet SaaS Pricing Matrix
description: A light, editorial SaaS pricing page led by a full-width grouped comparison matrix with a sticky 3-plan header, electric-violet accent, and a monthly/annual toggle.

description: A frameless dark-mode SaaS pricing page with a 3-tier card grid, monthly-annual toggle and a glowing electric-mint highlighted plan, built for developer and design tools.

title: Emerald 4-Tier SaaS Pricing Table
description: A light-mode emerald-accented SaaS pricing page with a Monthly/Annual toggle and four tiers fused into one bordered table, the Pro column lifted and ring-highlighted as 'Most popular'.

title: Electric-Lime Single-Plan SaaS Pricing
description: A bold editorial single-plan pricing page with a giant toggling price card, a tilted sky-blue feature card, and one electric-lime accent on warm paper inside a charcoal frame.

title: Electric Magenta Creator-SaaS Pricing
description: A bright-white creator-marketplace SaaS pricing page with an electric magenta accent, a billing toggle, four tier cards (dark inverted 'Most popular'), a magenta earnings stat band, and a grouped comparison table.

title: Slate ROI-Calculator Pricing
description: A frameless dark SaaS pricing page in inky slate with one electric mint accent: an interactive ROI savings calculator, a 4-tier plan grid with a highlighted Pro card and monthly/annual toggle, a comparison table, and an accordion FAQ.

title: Warm Editorial SaaS Pricing
description: A cozy, editorial three-tier SaaS pricing page in a cream-and-clay palette with a serif display headline, a highlighted dark center tier, a monthly/yearly toggle, and a friendly FAQ.

title: Editorial Cream + Ink Two-Path SaaS Pricing
description: A warm editorial SaaS pricing page on a cream canvas: a serif headline with an electric-blue italic accent, two self-serve plan cards (one highlighted) beside a dark near-black Enterprise contact-sales panel with gold accents, plus a monthly/annual toggle.

title: Gilded Atelier Dark-Serif Pricing
description: A luxe dark, gold-on-black editorial SaaS pricing page with a high-contrast serif, an elevated glowing featured tier, monthly/annual toggle, and a refined FAQ accordion.

title: Warm Editorial Cream Pricing
description: A warm cream-paper SaaS pricing page with a terracotta accent, Fraunces serif display type, and three reflowing tiers anchored by a lifted 'Most popular' middle card.

title: Animated Scroll-Printed Product Page: Warm Cream and Red Editorial With a Horizontal Card Rail
description: An animated, scroll-driven LANDING or PRODUCT page in a warm print register: cream #e7e2d8, ink #171717 and one hot red #ef493c, with Anton set huge and Martian Mono carrying every label at +0.18em. Five sections pin as you scroll. A poster hero whose type lifts, shrinks and fades on three separate variables. A manifesto line that fills from grey to ink through a bottom-up clip-path wipe. A horizontal rail of product cards that travels sideways as you scroll down. A pinned stage where the product's paper artifact is PRINTED in front of you, filling in its lot number, its test result and its dates before a dashed perforation opens across it. A parallax plate whose chapters swap underneath a headline. Every headline splits into per-word spans and roughly 200 elements move independently. Driven entirely by CSS custom properties written from one requestAnimationFrame-throttled scroll handler, with no animation library. Reusable for any catalogue, shop, maker, food, garden or artisan brand that ships a physical thing.

title: Animated Swiss Poster Landing Page: Warm Paper and Red With a Scroll-Driven Live Timeline
description: An animated LANDING PAGE in a Swiss poster register: warm paper #F8F3EC, ink #111010 and one hot red #DC201E, with Anton set huge, Archivo for body and JetBrains Mono at +0.26em for every label. Four sections pin as you scroll. A hero over a 44px ruled grid that parallaxes. A statement filled left to right by a scroll-driven clip-path. A LIVE TIMELINE where an elapsed clock, a distance and a status label are all interpolated from one series of minute marks, so they can never disagree with the row that is lit. A drawn street network with a route traced to your scroll position. Every headline splits into per-word spans and roughly 175 elements move independently. No images, no animation library, 2px rules and zero radii. Reusable for a courier, logistics, trades, clinic, garage or any service business whose promise is a measurable time.

title: Agency Website: Bold Editorial Newspaper Broadsheet Studio Site
description: An agency website design prompt in a bold editorial, newspaper-broadsheet style: a vintage front page turned studio homepage. One ink only (near-black on off-white newsprint with paper grain), grayscale photography, and three type voices in high contrast: a delicate old-style serif masthead nameplate between double rules, heavy condensed-sans headlines, and a justified vintage-serif body with a drop cap. Hairline rules do all the structure: edition bar, dateline, ruled nav, three-column services, framed portfolio plates, a letters-to-the-editor pull quote, a classified-style client register, and a double-rule commission CTA. An editorial noir look for any design studio, agency, or portfolio site.

title: Graphic Comparison Report
description: A highly visual, typography-driven comparison report design. This style eschews traditional tables and icons for a bold, editorial layout inspired by graphic posters. Featuring a brutalist-lite aesthetic with high-contrast 'ink' and 'paper' tones, it utilizes oversized headlines, a strict 12-column grid, and structural 2px borders. Suitable for technical comparisons, whitepapers, B2B SaaS decision pages, fintech analysis, and deep-dive product evaluations where clarity and authority are paramount.

title: Risograph Pricing Page: Bold Spot-Ink SaaS Plans
description: A bold risograph SaaS pricing page: warm cream paper with federal-blue and fluoro-pink spot inks, halftone dot fields, overprint that multiplies to purple, deliberate mis-registration, grain, and hard flat offset "print" shadows on the cards. Three clear tiers (Starter / Studio featured / Press) with a big bold price on each, a monthly/annual segmented-pill toggle with a "Save 20%" tag, a "Most popular" badge on the ink-inverted featured plan, per-tier CTAs and checked feature lists, a monochrome "Trusted by" logo strip, a 4-card FAQ, a solid-blue CTA band, and a footer. Bricolage Grotesque display + DM Mono labels. Recognizable as a pricing page while carrying a real print-shop point of view. Reusable for any indie, creative-tool, or studio SaaS that wants pricing with personality.

title: Vintage Serif-Masthead Editorial Newspaper Poster
description: A vintage MONOCHROME newspaper-front-page editorial POSTER (A3 portrait) — near-black #141210 ink on a cream newsprint ground #f7f4ec, no color, no imagery. Three type families in high contrast: a high-contrast serif PLAYFAIR DISPLAY masthead nameplate (~138px, between a double rule), a heavy CONDENSED grotesque ANTON headline (~89px all-caps), Anton column sub-headers (~32px), and a justified Playfair serif body (~17px, multi-column). Structured entirely by hairline RULES: a top edition bar with mirrored labels, a three-up dateline with an italic tagline, a Public Sans eyebrow, and a three-column body split by vertical rules, closed by a footer line. Reusable for any vintage broadsheet / arts-culture / exhibition / zine poster.

title: Gritty Condensed-Caps Motivational Quote Poster
description: A portrait typographic motivational-quote POSTER carried entirely by type, gradient, and grain — no photos, no illustration. Near-black canvas #0a0a0a with a visible FILM-GRAIN overlay and a single warm radial glow (bright orange #e8692a into deep rust #a62f17) entering from the RIGHT edge so the left stays near-black. Palette is strictly black + white + that ONE warm gradient. Hero in ANTON (a tall CONDENSED grotesque, Oswald/Bebas fallback), white, ALL CAPS, set as a tight left-aligned multi-line caps stack (~212px, line-height 0.8) that fills most of the poster. A flowing GREAT VIBES script line sits top-right as an elegant counterpoint; a boxed monogram sits top-left; a full-width white hairline rule divides under the headline; a tracked ALL-CAPS footer label + year sit on the baseline over a small justified low-contrast body paragraph. Reusable for quote/motivational posters, album/event posters, gym/hype graphics, book covers, or any type-as-image statement piece.

title: Dark Editorial Three-Typeface Film-Festival Program Flyer
description: A portrait dark-editorial FILM-FESTIVAL PROGRAM flyer on a warm near-black #111214 field, built on a deliberate THREE-typeface system — Playfair Display for the display voice, a monospace for all times + edge labels (tabular nums), Public Sans for small utility sublabels. A monospace top rail over a hairline rule, a huge Playfair title with the middle word in italic amber #e8a33d, a warm-grey dek, then a hairline-DIVIDED program of rows (mono amber time | Playfair name + Public Sans sublabel | split two-tone pill 'Screen'+'A'), closed by a monospace footer rail. Hairlines divide the lineup instead of boxes; amber #e8a33d is the single accent. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for film/music/arts festival programs, screening/gig lineups, conference agendas, awards rundowns, and any dark-editorial list-of-times.

title: Folded-Paper Club Invite Email
description: An edgy, underground event RSVP email in a centered 600px column: a deep-black surface framing a bright-red hero panel that reads like a folded-paper flyer or ticket stub, with fold-crease grid lines and flat near-black type. The flyer embeds the key info (host, music, doors, date, location) plus an RSVP button; brief 'The Night' / 'Entry' text blocks sit below on black. Reusable for nightclubs, secret gigs, limited-capacity events, and streetwear drops.

title: Warm Terracotta Zebra-Schedule Event Program Flyer
description: An A4 portrait EVENT-PROGRAM / schedule flyer in a strict warm analogous terracotta palette — cream #fdf4ea canvas, bright orange #ee7420 Archivo Black header, full-bleed peach #f4b183 and cream ZEBRA-STRIPE schedule rows split by a soft orange divider bar, dark rust #8a3b1a organic corner blobs — with NO cool color. A big two-line uppercase heavy-grotesque header, a black wide-tracked subhead flanked by small orange star marks, a two-cell italic-Playfair info bar (org | date), and full-width alternating peach/cream schedule rows ("time – time | session") with NO borders or grid lines, over amoeba blob shapes and faint concentric-ring motifs, closing on a footer dash + tracked rust caps. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for agendas, conference rundowns, itineraries, timetables, class schedules, retreat programs, and any list-of-rows that wants to feel designed rather than tabular.

title: Gradient-Column Modern Art-Exhibition Poster
description: A modern ART-EXHIBITION POSTER (A3 portrait) — strictly near-black #141414 type on a cream #f2ede1 ground, where the ONLY color is a central band of SIX equal vertical GRADIENT columns (cobalt / spectrum / magenta / amber / olive / teal), each with a diagonal white sheen. A heavy geometric ARCHIVO BLACK wordmark centers the top; PUBLIC SANS 700 caps carry the corner metadata and a centered dot-separated artist-name list; a gradient-FILLED 'ART' wordmark (background-clip: text) sits bottom-left. Reusable for any gallery / museum exhibition, design or type show, or arts-festival poster wanting a heavy caps wordmark over vibrant color-as-content.

title: PROMPTSMITH // People Who Stopped Staring at Blank Canvas
description: Loud neo-brutalist testimonial 'wall of proof' section for a prompt-to-UI product, on warm paper #f4f1ea with near-black ink #0a0a0a and ONE electric acid-lime accent #e8ff00. A sticky paper nav (ink + acid lightning logo, mono links, acid 'Start free' pill) over an ink->acid scrolling rating MARQUEE, then over a dotted-grain ground: a four-line Archivo-black headline ('PEOPLE / WHO STOPPED / STARING AT / BLANK CANVAS.' with the last line knocked out acid-on-ink) beside a two-cell 4.9 / 2.1k stat block, a row of filter pills, and a responsive 1/2/3-col grid of neo-brutalist testimonial cards (3px ink borders + 6px HARD offset shadows: a paper star card, an acid feature card, an inverted ink card with an acid hard-shadow, an acid pull-quote card with a giant quote glyph) with 'via X' + verified-seal trust accents and square ink/acid initials tiles. Closes on an inverted ink CTA strip ('GOT A WIN TO SHARE?' + an acid 'Leave a testimonial' pill). Archivo + JetBrains Mono, Iconify Phosphor, CSS marquee.

title: Cobalt Single-Field Enrollment Promo Flyer with Floating CTA Card
description: A portrait single-field PROMO / enrollment FLYER staked entirely on ONE saturated cobalt #1a34d6 field with no chrome — color and big ARCHIVO BLACK type carry all the recognition. A small yellow eyebrow ('Enrollment open'), a massive unboxed headline set directly on the field with one word/line dropped to yellow ('Learn / to ship / in 6 weeks'), a soft off-cobalt radial glow from the top-right, and a faint film-grain overlay. ALL functional content lives in ONE floating soft-white #eef1ff card near the bottom: an offer title, a one-line value description, and a cobalt pill CTA closed by a yellow circular chevron dot. The single warm yellow #ffd23f is rationed to the offer only. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for course/cohort enrollment, bootcamp/workshop promos, sale/discount announcements, product drops, and any single-offer flyer that should read as a poster.

title: LexaFlow AI - Legal Review Hub
description:
Build a FULLY FUNCTIONAL interactive prototype for an internal legal contract review app. Single-page HTML application with state management and full interactivity.

STRUCTURE:
1. Start Page (Action Queue):
   - 4 lanes: "Ready to Review", "Blocked", "Ready to Decide", "Ready to Hand Off"
   - 5 realistic sample cases distributed across lanes
   - Click any case to open Request Details page
   - Triage summary bar at top shows count of cases in each lane

2. Request Details Page:
   - Full case information hierarchy (ID, title, priority, status, ownership, due date, context fields)
   - AI case brief section (clearly labeled as AI-generated)
   - Primary CTA (changes based on case state: Review, Unblock, Make Decision, Hand Off)
   - Case sections: Description, Attachments (grouped), Stakeholders, Communication Thread, Audit Log
   - Progressive disclosure: Secondary info in collapsible drawers/panels

3. INTERACTIVE BEHAVIORS:
   a) Block/Unblock Flow:
      - When case is blocked, UI switches to "blocked mode" (visual distinction, top accent bar)
      - Blocker reason is prominent
      - Primary CTA: "Escalate to [Owner]" or "Follow Up with [Stakeholder]"
      - "Unblock" button opens modal to record resolution
      - Clicking unblock moves case back to previous action type lane
      - Audit log records: who blocked, reason, who unblocked, resolution, timestamp

   b) Make Decision Flow:
      - "Ready to Decide" cases show key risk identified by AI
      - 3 action buttons: "Approve", "Approve with Conditions", "Escalate/Reject"
      - Clicking any decision opens modal with reason input field
      - After decision, case moves to "Ready to Hand Off" lane
      - Audit log records decision, reason, who decided, timestamp

   c) Hand Off Flow:
      - Shows next owner and handoff checklist
      - "Complete Handoff" button opens modal with pre-filled next owner
      - After handoff, case moves to completed state (case disappears from queue or moves to history)
      - Audit log records handoff info

   d) Audit Trail:
      - Full timeline of all actions: created, reviewed changes, decisions made, blocks/unblocks, handoffs
      - Each entry shows: action, actor, timestamp, reason/notes, AI involvement (if applicable)
      - Audit log is read-only and always visible in case details

4. SAMPLE DATA (5 cases):
   - Case 1: "Globex Vendor Agreement" - Ready to Review, HIGH priority, due in 2 days, new redline detected
   - Case 2: "InfoSec SLA Amendment" - Blocked, waiting on InfoSec clarification, assigned to Marcus (you're waiting on him)
   - Case 3: "Cloud Services MSA" - Ready to Decide, medium risk identified, needs legal judgment
   - Case 4: "Maintenance Contract Renewal" - Ready to Hand Off, legal review complete, going to Procurement
   - Case 5: "Data Processing Agreement" - Blocked, missing client input, overdue (escalation needed)

5. VISUAL DESIGN:
   - Modern enterprise aesthetic, clean hierarchy
   - Color-coded action types (blue=review, red/orange=blocked, amber=decide, green=handoff)
   - Use distinctive typography for scanning (Plus Jakarta Sans or similar)
   - Modal dialogs for confirmations and reason inputs
   - Toast notifications for state changes ("Case unblocked!", "Decision recorded")
   - Audit log uses compact timeline format (not tables)

6. TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION:
   - Use vanilla JS with DOM state management (no frameworks)
   - Data stored in local state (not persistent, just for demo)
   - Navigation between Start Page and Case Details via JS (no page reloads)
   - Forms with validation before state change
   - Real timestamps for audit entries
   - Progressive disclosure using data-state attributes and CSS classes

CRITICAL INTERACTION REQUIREMENTS:
- Block state logic: When case is blocked, "Review" button is disabled, blocker reason blocks the primary action path
- Unblock modal: Requires reason input before allowing state change
- Decision modal: Requires one of 3 decision options + optional reason
- Handoff modal: Shows next owner, checklist status, and requires confirmation
- Audit log: Always shows complete history, updates in real-time as actions occur
- State persistence across page views: If user blocks a case, goes back to start page, then re-enters case, it's still blocked

Enterprise focus, clear accountability, no generic dashboards.
